column1: # InterGenOS build-watcher SBU budget table — work-plan 1.15, spec §4.
# Consumed by scripts/build-watcher.sh. Format:  package<TAB>sbu<TAB>source
# The KEY is the package name as build-watcher derives it from a per-package log
#   basename after stripping the timestamp AND the driver phase marker
#   (-chroot/-ch8/-ch10): "webkitgtk-<ts>.log" -> "webkitgtk", "gcc-ch8-<ts>.log"
#   -> "gcc". Keys therefore match the real LOG-derived names, not recipe dirs
#   ("gcc-core" is the recipe dir; the ch8 driver logs it as gcc-ch8 -> key "gcc";
#   corrected 2026-07-09, live-defect #3).
# 1 SBU = binutils-pass1's MEASURED wall time on THIS run (the calibration anchor).
#   Launch-5 measured 3m13s (193 s) on the current build VM. build-watcher.sh
#   measures the anchor itself from the logs when --calibration is not passed and
#   prints the derived seconds-per-SBU in its first CHECKIN line.
# budget_seconds(pkg) = sbu * calibration_seconds_per_SBU.
# Packages ABSENT from this table budget at the DEFAULT CLASS: 30 min WALL (1800 s,
#   fixed, NOT sbu-scaled) — generous by design; the tripwire hunts order-of-magnitude
#   runaways, not 2x slowness (spec §4). ALARM at 3x budget, HALT-condition at 5x.
#   A package only NEEDS a row here if its legitimate wall time exceeds 3x the default
#   (90 min) — otherwise the default already accommodates it without a false alarm.
# lib32 twins with no book SBU: source token "sibling:<name>" -> the sibling's budget
#   x 2.5 (doctrine §7.2), resolved at runtime.
# SOURCE precedence (the rust L15-r3 lesson, spec §4): MEASURED beats book. Book SBUs
#   can include test/LLVM time we skip, so a measured row ("measured:<date>") is used
#   wherever an on-metal wall time exists; book rows are the fallback. This table grows
#   as the burn's forensic trace yields more measured rows.
# glibc also carries a HARD 40-min wall cap inside the watcher (dual-width recursion
#   tripwire, doctrine §7): configure-run count > 2 OR make-syscalls > 120 OR wall
#   > 40 min all fire RECURSION-SIGNATURE independently of this budget row.
# Toolchain gcc-pass1/gcc-pass2 have no measured trace on disk yet and are not known
#   to exceed 90 min, so they use the default class; add measured rows from the burn
#   trace if either proves long (measured-beats-book growth model).
